content: Standard pattern for user-uploaded media: client uploads/backend-generated files go to S3-compatible object storage; presigned URLs (short expiry, 15-60 min) let clients upload directly to storage without proxying bytes through the app backend, avoiding backend bandwidth bottleneck. Serve/download side fronts storage with a CDN (e.g. CloudFront) for caching and reduced latency. Presigned URLs are bearer-token-like (anyone with the URL can access), so short expiry and scoping matter.
